Ui.Script:
BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART = "Interface\\Benilla\\journal\\" BENILLA_FISHING_ART = "Interface\\Benilla\\fishing\\" BENILLA_JOURNAL_FISH_SLOTS = 10 BENILLA_JOURNAL_PER_ROW = 5 BENILLA_JOURNAL_LEGEND_SLOTS = 4 BENILLA_JOURNAL_SLOT = 48 -- The catch counts that unlock a page's three tiers: `[journal] reveal_at` in fish.toml. BENILLA_JOURNAL_REVEAL_AT = { 5, 10, 25 } BENILLA_JOURNAL_HINT = "You have heard a rumour of a legendary fish in these waters." BENILLA_JOURNAL_PROFESSIONS = { { key = "fishing", icon = "prof_fishing", live = true }, { key = "herbalism", icon = "prof_herbalism", live = false, tip = "Herbalism: coming soon" }, } BENILLA_JOURNAL_PAGES = { "Zones", "Inventory", "Progression" } -- AreaTable id to the scene `journal\zone_<key>`; a zone missing here shows no scene. BENILLA_JOURNAL_ZONE_ART = { [12] = "elwynn", [1519] = "stormwind", [44] = "redridge", [10] = "duskwood" }
BINDING_HEADER_BENILLAFISHING = "Fishing" BINDING_NAME_TOGGLEFISHINGJOURNAL = "Toggle Fishing Journal"
-- The count of `item` the bags hold. function BenillaFishingJournal_ItemCount(item) local total = 0 if not item then return 0 end for bag = 0, 4 do for slot = 1, GetContainerNumSlots(bag) do local link = GetContainerItemLink(bag, slot) if link then local _, _, id = string.find(link, "item:(%d+)") if tonumber(id) == item then local _, count = GetContainerItemInfo(bag, slot) total = total + (count or 1) end end end end return total end
-- An item's icon, or the placeholder fish when the client does not know it. function BenillaFishingJournal_Icon(item) if item then local _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, texture = GetItemInfo(item) if texture then return texture end end return BENILLA_FISHING_ART .. "fish" end
function BenillaFishingJournal_Pips(slot, caught, perfect, legendary) local name = slot:GetName() local on = { caught, perfect, legendary } for i = 1, 3 do local pip = getglobal(name .. "Pip" .. i) pip:SetTexture(BENILLA_FISHING_ART .. (on[i] and "pip_on" or "pip_off")) pip:Show() end end
function BenillaFishingJournal_HidePips(slot) local name = slot:GetName() for i = 1, 3 do getglobal(name .. "Pip" .. i):Hide() end end
function BenillaFishingJournal_ItemName(item) local name = item and GetItemInfo(item) return name or "an unknown item" end
-- A slot's face: `state` is "caught" (the item's icon), "silhouette" (a dark fish), "dark" -- (a dark slot) or "empty" (nothing). The name under the slot is the caller's. function BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, state, item) local name = slot:GetName() local icon = getglobal(name .. "Icon") slot.item = item slot.caught = (state == "caught") slot.state = state getglobal(name .. "Label"):SetText("") getglobal(name .. "Name"):SetText("") if state == "caught" then icon:SetTexture(BenillaFishingJournal_Icon(item)) icon:SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) icon:Show() elseif state == "silhouette" then icon:SetTexture(BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART .. "silhouette") icon:SetVertexColor(1, 1, 1) icon:Show() else icon:Hide() end if state ~= "caught" then BenillaFishingJournal_HidePips(slot) end slot:Show() end
function BenillaFishingJournal_PaintBait() local bait = GetFishingJournal() local slot = BenillaFishingJournalBait BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, bait and "caught" or "empty", bait) slot.kind = "bait" BenillaFishingJournalBaitCount:SetText(bait and BenillaFishingJournal_ItemCount(bait) or "") BenillaFishingJournalBaitHint:SetText(bait and "" or "Drop bait here") end
-- The Pole and Lure slots. The Lure shows its durability as "14/20". function BenillaFishingJournal_PaintGear() local pole, lure, durability, max = GetFishingGear() local slot = BenillaFishingJournalPole BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, pole and "caught" or "empty", pole) slot.kind = "pole" BenillaFishingJournalPoleHint:SetText(pole and "" or "Drop a pole here") slot = BenillaFishingJournalLure BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, lure and "caught" or "empty", lure) slot.kind = "lure" slot.durability = lure and (durability .. " / " .. max) or nil BenillaFishingJournalLureCount:SetText(lure and (durability .. "/" .. max) or "") BenillaFishingJournalLureHint:SetText(lure and "" or "Drop a lure here") end
-- The Legendary Fish of `zoneName`: a flat list of item, hintFound, caught triples. function BenillaFishingJournal_ZoneLegends(zoneName) local all = { GetFishingLegends() } local mine = {} for i = 1, table.getn(all), 4 do if all[i + 1] == zoneName then table.insert(mine, { all[i], all[i + 2], all[i + 3] }) end end return mine, all end
-- Paint the fish grid from `zone`, whose slot n reads zone[2n + 2] and zone[2n + 3] after -- the name, id and description. Returns how many fish are caught and how many there are. function BenillaFishingJournal_PaintFish(zone, legends) local caughtLegend = {} for i = 1, table.getn(legends), 4 do if legends[i + 3] then caughtLegend[legends[i]] = true end end local collected, total = 0, 0 for n = 1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_FISH_SLOTS do local slot = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalFish" .. n) slot.kind = "fish" local item = zone[2 * n + 2] local best = zone[2 * n + 3] if not item then slot:Hide() else total = total + 1 local label = getglobal(slot:GetName() .. "Name") if best and best > 0 then collected = collected + 1 BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, "caught", item) BenillaFishingJournal_Pips(slot, true, best >= 2, caughtLegend[item]) label:SetText(BenillaFishingJournal_ItemName(item)) else BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, "silhouette", item) label:SetText("???") end end end return collected, total end
-- Paint the zone's four legend panels. Returns how many are caught. function BenillaFishingJournal_PaintLegends(zoneName) local mine = BenillaFishingJournal_ZoneLegends(zoneName) local collected = 0 for n = 1, BENILLA_JOURNAL_LEGEND_SLOTS do local slot = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalLegend" .. n) slot.kind = "legend" local row = mine[n] local label = getglobal(slot:GetName() .. "Name") slot.hint = nil if row and row[3] then collected = collected + 1 BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, "caught", row[1]) label:SetText(BenillaFishingJournal_ItemName(row[1])) else BenillaFishingJournal_Face(slot, "silhouette", row and row[1]) label:SetText("???") if row and row[2] then slot.hint = BENILLA_JOURNAL_HINT end end end return collected end
-- "Water, Zone" for a named Fishing Water, else just the zone. function BenillaFishingJournal_Place(zone, water) if water and water ~= "" then return water .. ", " .. zone end return zone end
-- The page's text lines for `item`: its places, then one line per tier. function BenillaFishingJournal_PageLines(item) local caught, perfect, revealed, nextReveal, places, lives, kinds, peakFrom, peakTo, bait = GetFishPage(item) local lines = {} for i = 1, places do local zone, water, count = GetFishPagePlace(item, i) table.insert(lines, BenillaFishingJournal_Place(zone, water) .. ": " .. count) end local locked = 0 for tier = 1, 3 do if tier > revealed then local need = (locked == 0) and nextReveal or BENILLA_JOURNAL_REVEAL_AT[tier] locked = locked + 1 table.insert(lines, "??? (catch " .. need .. " to learn)") elseif tier == 1 then local homes = {} for i = 1, lives do local zone, water = GetFishPageHabitat(item, i) table.insert(homes, BenillaFishingJournal_Place(zone, water)) end table.insert(lines, "Lives in: " .. (lives > 0 and table.concat(homes, "; ") or "anywhere")) elseif tier == 2 then local water = (kinds == "") and "any" or string.gsub(kinds, ",", ", ") table.insert(lines, "Water: " .. water) if peakFrom then table.insert(lines, string.format("Bites most: %d:00 to %d:00", peakFrom, peakTo)) else table.insert(lines, "Bites at any hour") end else table.insert(lines, "Favourite bait: " .. (bait and BenillaFishingJournal_ItemName(bait) or "none")) end end return lines, caught, perfect end
-- Show or grey a texture; the grey is a 0.4 vertex colour where the API lacks the call. function BenillaJournal_Grey(texture, grey) if texture.SetDesaturated then texture:SetDesaturated(grey and 1 or nil) else local v = grey and 0.4 or 1 texture:SetVertexColor(v, v, v) end end
-- The bookmark column: the selected profession's tab is `side_tab_selected`, a profession -- that is not live is grey. function BenillaJournal_PaintProfessions() local chosen = BenillaFishingJournal.profession or "fishing" for i = 1, table.getn(BENILLA_JOURNAL_PROFESSIONS) do local row = BENILLA_JOURNAL_PROFESSIONS[i] local button = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalProf" .. i) local bg = getglobal(button:GetName() .. "Bg") local icon = getglobal(button:GetName() .. "Icon") button.key = row.key button.live = row.live button.tip = row.tip button.selected = (row.key == chosen) bg:SetTexture(BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART .. (button.selected and "side_tab_selected" or "side_tab")) icon:SetTexture(BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART .. row.icon) BenillaJournal_Grey(bg, not row.live) BenillaJournal_Grey(icon, not row.live) end end
function BenillaJournalProfession_OnClick() local button = this if not button.live then return end BenillaFishingJournal.profession = button.key BenillaJournal_PaintProfessions() end
function BenillaJournalProfession_OnEnter() local button = this if button.live or not button.tip or not GameTooltip then return end GameTooltip:SetOwner(button, "ANCHOR_LEFT") GameTooltip:SetText(button.tip) GameTooltip:Show() end
-- Show the child frame of one bottom tab and hide the others. function BenillaJournal_ShowPage(name) BenillaFishingJournal.pageName = name for i = 1, table.getn(BENILLA_JOURNAL_PAGES) do local page = BENILLA_JOURNAL_PAGES[i] local child = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournal" .. page) local bg = getglobal("BenillaFishingJournalTab" .. i .. "Bg") if page == name then child:Show() bg:SetTexture(BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART .. "bottom_tab_selected") else child:Hide() bg:SetTexture(BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART .. "bottom_tab") end end end
-- 1234567 as "1,234,567". function BenillaJournal_Commas(n) local s = string.format("%d", n or 0) local k repeat s, k = string.gsub(s, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2") until k == 0 return s end
function BenillaJournalTalent_OnEnter() if not GameTooltip then return end GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText("Fishing talents are coming later.") GameTooltip:Show() end
-- The Progression page: the level badge, title and XP bar, the locked tree and five stats. function BenillaJournal_PaintProgression() local p = "BenillaFishingJournalProgression" local level, xp, toNext, title = GetAnglerInfo() getglobal(p .. "Level"):SetText(level) getglobal(p .. "Title"):SetText(title or "") local fill = getglobal(p .. "XpFill") if level == 0 then getglobal(p .. "XpText"):SetText("0 / 0 XP") fill:Hide() else fill:Show() if toNext > 0 then fill:SetWidth(math.max(1, 186 * math.min(xp / toNext, 1))) getglobal(p .. "XpText"):SetText(BenillaJournal_Commas(xp) .. " / " .. BenillaJournal_Commas(toNext) .. " XP") else fill:SetWidth(186) getglobal(p .. "XpText"):SetText("Max level") end end local _, zoneCount, casts, caught = GetFishingJournal() local seen, known, counted, found, discovered = {}, 0, {}, 0, 0 for z = 1, zoneCount do local zone = { GetFishingJournalZone(z) } local hit = false for i = 4, table.getn(zone), 2 do local item, best = zone[i], zone[i + 1] if not seen[item] then seen[item] = true known = known + 1 end if best and best > 0 then hit = true if not counted[item] then counted[item] = true found = found + 1 end end end if hit then discovered = discovered + 1 end end local legends = { GetFishingLegends() } local legendCaught, legendTotal = 0, 0 for i = 1, table.getn(legends), 4 do legendTotal = legendTotal + 1 if legends[i + 3] then legendCaught = legendCaught + 1 end end local labels = { "Total Fish Caught", "Unique Fish", "Legendary Fish", "Zones Discovered", "Total Casts" } local values = { BenillaJournal_Commas(caught), found .. " / " .. known, legendCaught .. " / " .. legendTotal, discovered .. " / " .. zoneCount, BenillaJournal_Commas(casts), } for i = 1, 5 do getglobal(p .. "StatLabel" .. i):SetText(labels[i]) getglobal(p .. "StatValue" .. i):SetText(values[i]) local stripe = getglobal(p .. "Stripe" .. i) if math.mod(i, 2) == 1 then stripe:SetTexture(1, 1, 1, 0.08) else stripe:SetTexture(0, 0, 0, 0.25) end end end
function BenillaFishingJournal_Paint() local frame = BenillaFishingJournal BenillaJournal_ShowPage(frame.pageName or BENILLA_JOURNAL_PAGES[1]) BenillaJournal_PaintProfessions() BenillaFishingJournal_PaintBait() BenillaFishingJournal_PaintGear() BenillaJournal_PaintProgression() local _, count = GetFishingJournal() local page = frame.page or 1 page = math.max(1, math.min(page, math.max(count, 1))) frame.page = page local zone = { GetFishingJournalZone(page) } local zoneName = zone[1] or "" local art = BENILLA_JOURNAL_ZONE_ART[zone[2] or 0] if art then BenillaFishingJournalScene:SetTexture(BENILLA_JOURNAL_ART .. "zone_" .. art) BenillaFishingJournalScene:Show() else BenillaFishingJournalScene:Hide() end BenillaFishingJournalZoneName:SetText(zoneName) BenillaFishingJournalDescription:SetText(zone[3] or "") BenillaFishingJournalPage:SetText(count > 0 and (page .. " / " .. count) or "") if count > 1 then BenillaFishingJournalPrev:Show() BenillaFishingJournalNext:Show() else BenillaFishingJournalPrev:Hide() BenillaFishingJournalNext:Hide() end local _, all = BenillaFishingJournal_ZoneLegends(zoneName) local collected, total = BenillaFishingJournal_PaintFish(zone, all) BenillaFishingJournalCommonCount:SetText(collected .. " / " .. total .. " Collected") local legends = BenillaFishingJournal_PaintLegends(zoneName) BenillaFishingJournalLegendCount:SetText(legends .. " / " .. BENILLA_JOURNAL_LEGEND_SLOTS .. " Collected") end
function BenillaFishingJournal_Turn(step) local frame = BenillaFishingJournal frame.page = (frame.page or 1) + step BenillaFishingJournal_Paint() end
function BenillaFishingJournal_Toggle() if BenillaFishingJournal:IsShown() then BenillaFishingJournal:Hide() else BenillaFishingJournal:Show() end end
-- A bait item dropped from the bags becomes the bait. function BenillaFishingJournalBait_Receive() local item = BenillaGetCursorItem() if item then SetFishingBait(item) ClearCursor() end end
-- A pole or lure dropped from the bags goes into its slot; the realm refuses any other item. function BenillaFishingJournalGear_Receive(which) local bag, slot = BenillaGetCursorItemPos() if bag then SetFishingGear(which, bag, slot) ClearCursor() end end
function BenillaFishingJournalSlot_OnClick(button) local slot = this if slot == BenillaFishingJournalBait then if button == "RightButton" then SetFishingBait(nil) else BenillaFishingJournalBait_Receive() end elseif slot == BenillaFishingJournalPole or slot == BenillaFishingJournalLure then local which = (slot == BenillaFishingJournalPole) and "POLE" or "LURE" if button == "RightButton" then ClearFishingGear(which) else BenillaFishingJournalGear_Receive(which) end end end
function BenillaFishingJournalSlot_OnEnter() local slot = this if not GameTooltip then return end GameTooltip:SetOwner(slot, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") if slot.caught and slot.item then GameTooltip:SetHyperlink("item:" .. slot.item .. ":0:0:0") if slot.kind == "lure" and slot.durability then GameTooltip:AddLine("Durability " .. slot.durability, 1, 1, 1) elseif slot.kind == "fish" and GetFishPage(slot.item) then GameTooltip:AddLine(" ") local lines = BenillaFishingJournal_PageLines(slot.item) for i = 1, table.getn(lines) do GameTooltip:AddLine(lines[i], 1, 1, 1, 1) end end elseif slot.kind == "fish" then GameTooltip:SetText("???") GameTooltip:AddLine("Catch it to learn more.", 1, 1, 1, 1) elseif slot.kind == "pole" then GameTooltip:SetText("Fishing pole") GameTooltip:AddLine("Drop a pole from your bags here. Right-click to clear.", 1, 1, 1, 1) elseif slot.kind == "lure" then GameTooltip:SetText("Lure") GameTooltip:AddLine("Drop a lure from your bags here. Right-click to clear.", 1, 1, 1, 1) elseif slot.kind == "bait" then GameTooltip:SetText("Bait") GameTooltip:AddLine("Drop bait from your bags here. Right-click to clear.", 1, 1, 1, 1) elseif slot.hint then GameTooltip:SetText("Legendary fish") GameTooltip:AddLine(slot.hint, 1, 1, 1, 1) else GameTooltip:SetText("???") end GameTooltip:Show() end
function BenillaFishingJournalSlot_OnLeave() if GameTooltip then GameTooltip:Hide() end end
function BenillaFishingJournal_OnEvent() if BenillaFishingJournal:IsShown() then BenillaFishingJournal_Paint() end end
SLASH_BENILLAJOURNAL1 = "/journal" SlashCmdList["BENILLAJOURNAL"] = function() BenillaFishingJournal_Toggle() end

Scripts.OnLoad: this:RegisterEvent("FISHING_JOURNAL_UPDATE") this:RegisterEvent("BAG_UPDATE") this:RegisterEvent("ANGLER_UPDATE") if UISpecialFrames then tinsert(UISpecialFrames, "BenillaFishingJournal") end
